title: All the AI agents that can live in your text messages | TechCrunch
summary: Users can communicate with Instinct by text or voice and connect it to the apps and services they already use, such as email, calendar, Google Workspace, and more. In September, Instinct began giving users dedicated email addresses for their assistants.
